name: Tokawa Yukiko
source:
Kimie's younger sister and Jun's aunt.

She never married and has been a priestess since she was old enough to be a priestess. She is a pure and innocent woman who is a little bit out of the world.

She has never had a man in her life, and she is faithful to the rule that a miko must be a virgin. She has been distrustful of men ever since she had a problem with a past boyfriend.

She has a quiet and reserved personality, but she is possessed, When she is possessed, she has a dual personality and is a very bold and determined older sister.
